WITH color_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.product_color, 'No Color') AS color,
    COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  LEFT JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.product_color, 'No Color')
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_items,
    AVG(count) AS avg_count
  FROM color_counts
),
filtered_colors AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.color,
    cc.count,
    cc.count * 1.0 / os.total_items AS share,
    cc.count - os.avg_count AS excess
  FROM color_counts cc, overall_stats os
  WHERE cc.count > os.avg_count
)
SELECT
  AVG(count) AS average_count,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(excess) AS average_excess
FROM filtered_colors
